title: Versioned Pre-filter Plan Diff Contract v1.1
description: Canonical contract describing the storage layout, artifact formats, numbered plan view, allowed plan-revision operations and line-numbered diff semantics for versioned Pre-filter plans. Consumed by app.agents.plan_state (Python implementation) and any external validators.

version_lines.position: before first hunk or between hunks only

notes: current_plan.md always contains the latest canonical plan body.
plans/history.json is the ONLY structured state and holds versions + diffs.
The canonical file MUST NOT diverge from get_current().content.
Upgrade from 1.0 to 1.1 is tolerant — legacy history files are loaded and bootstrapped from the canonical file when history.json is absent.
notes_addendum: Version numbers are monotonic; every accepted plan increments the version.

content.description: Full canonical plan body at this version (no markers, no wrappers, no diff hunks).

summary.description: Optional human-readable summary of what changed.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the version was created.

from_version.description: Previous plan version the diff applies to.

to_version.description: New plan version produced by applying the diff.

old_start.description: 1-based start line in the previous plan.

old_lines.description: Number of old-side lines; 0 for pure insertion.

new_start.description: 1-based start line in the new plan.

new_lines.description: Number of new-side lines; 0 for pure deletion.

lines.description: Body lines with a mandatory prefix character (' ' context, '-' removal, '+' addition).

numbered_plan_view.description: Stable line-numbered rendering of the current canonical plan for advisory contexts. Numbers are 1-based, zero-padded to 4 digits. The format is advisory only; it is not part of the canonical plan body.
rules: Line numbers are 1-based and zero-padded to exactly 4 digits.
Empty physical lines are numbered too.
Numbering is advisory and refers ONLY to the last canonical plan version.
The line-number prefixes are NEVER part of the canonical body.

full_rewrite.description: Replace the entire canonical plan with a complete new body. Always allowed.

replace_range.description: Replace the inclusive line range [start_line, end_line] with new lines.

insert_before.description: Insert new lines immediately before start_line.

insert_after.description: Insert new lines immediately after end_line.

delete_range.description: Delete the inclusive line range [start_line, end_line].

line_ranges.count_rule: count == 0 means pure insertion; count == 0 on the old side means the hunk inserts new lines only.

canonical_body_rules: Canonical plan text only — no markers, no wrappers.
The body MUST NOT contain ###Plan##### / ###PlanDiff##### markers.
The body MUST NOT contain @@ hunk headers or _build_prefilter_advice_section_agent wrappers.
The body MUST NOT contain [USER PLAN FEEDBACK] audit markers.
full_rewrite_rules.description: Full rewrites are always accepted and always win over diff-only responses when both are present.
full_rewrite_rules.unterminated_marker_recovery: If exactly one PLAN_MARKER is present and the response does NOT also contain a completed PLAN_DIFF_MARKER...PLAN_DIFF_MARKER pair (first start + following end per _extract_between semantics), the text after the single marker is recovered as the full-plan body (one-marker full-rewrite recovery). When a completed diff pair IS present, the diff branch takes precedence.
full_rewrite_rules.trailing_marker_line_trim: After extraction, trailing physical lines whose entire content equals PLAN_MARKER or PLAN_DIFF_MARKER are trimmed from the full-plan body. Markers embedded inside normal prose lines are not touched. If the trimmed body is empty, the response is rejected as missing_plan.

diff_rules.description: Diff-only responses apply a unified diff to the previous canonical plan.
diff_rules.context_verification: For each hunk, the old-side context/removal lines MUST match the previous plan byte-for-byte at the given range; mismatch is a hard error (conflict) with no partial write.
notes: count == 0 on the old side means pure insertion.
CRLF/CR are normalised to LF before parsing; line endings do not contribute to errors.
diff_rules.version_line_position_rule: Optional '--- vN' / '+++ vN+1' lines are ignored ONLY outside a hunk (before the first '@@' header) OR after a completed hunk where the next significant line is an '@@' header. A '-'-prefixed removal payload whose content begins with '--...' inside a hunk is retained as a '-' body line.
diff_rules.body_indentation: Body lines MUST use column-0 prefixes: ' ' (context), '-' (removal), '+' (addition). The only allowed leading space is a single ' ' context prefix. Visually indented diff bodies (2+ leading spaces followed by '-', '+', or '@') are rejected as unreadable_diff with a 'column 0' hint.
diff_rules.no_line_number_prefixes_in_body_hint: Hunk body lines that contain a 'NNNN|' zero-padded 4-digit line-number prefix are rejected as unreadable_diff. The error message includes the 'NNNN|' / 'no_line_number_prefixes_in_body' hint.

canonical_file_rules.content: Only the latest canonical plan body (no markers, no wrappers, no diff hunks).
canonical_file_rules.atomic_write_details: Write to a same-directory temp file and os.replace it into place; fsync where possible.
canonical_file_rules.read_back_verification_details: After writing, read the file back and compare byte-for-byte with the intended content; raise PlanStateError on mismatch (no partial write).

error_rules.requirement: All invalid cases must produce a PlanUpdateResult with success=false, mode='error', a populated error string, and MUST NOT cause any partial write to current_plan.md.
error_rules.legacy_fail_closed_guard: In the legacy full-rewrite fallback (no valid full block and no diff marker) responses that contain an unresolved PLAN_DIFF_MARKER, any column-0 '@@' hunk header, standalone marker lines, or 'NNNN|' zero-padded line-number prefixes are REJECTED as mode='error' (unreadable_diff / missing_plan) and never written to disk.

display_rules.tui_cli: TUI and CLI MUST display the full updated canonical plan without truncation.
display_rules.downstream: Orchestrator and Tester MUST receive the latest accepted canonical plan formatted through the existing advisory wrapper (never a raw diff-only response).
display_rules.downstream_canonical_note: Downstream consumers receive the LATEST canonical plan through the existing advisory wrapper. Raw diff blocks (PlanDiff markers, @@ hunk headers, NNNN| prefixes) are never forwarded downstream.
